description: This file defines a REST controller named HelloController for a Spring Boot application. It includes endpoints for a welcome message, API documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a simple welcome message as a String.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds and redirects to the Swagger UI URL, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a health status string indicating the application is operational.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a string containing basic application information.
